extDescription.message: Local-first web captures: save full pages or selections, organize, and preview offline

actionTitle.message: Thothsyn — click to save the page, right-click for more

selectTip.message: Hover to highlight · click to select · drag to box-select · Esc to exit

searchAria.message: Search captures: title, URL, or text

noTags.message: No tag folders yet (create one in Settings)

noMatchesHint.message: Try another keyword, or clear the search box.

emptyLibraryHint.message: Click the toolbar icon to save a page, or right-click and choose Save a selection.

dragTitle.message: Drag onto a folder on the left

previewFailed.message: Could not build the local preview. Hover again to retry.

optionsSub.message: Manage folders, imports, and preferences. Changes sync to the library immediately; sign-in and cloud sync are v2 placeholders.

businessHint.message: Single owner: each capture belongs to one business folder (drop = move)

tagHint.message: Multiple tags: a capture can have several tag folders (drop = add tag)

importHint.message: Import from the bookmarks bar or a bookmarks HTML file; imported records are independent

importMapHint.message: Top-level bookmarks folders become business folders; subfolders become tags

prefsHint.message: Applied immediately; no extension restart needed

deleteConfirmSub.message: Off by default: the × on each row deletes immediately. When on, an inline confirmation appears.

iconBlinkSub.message: Alternates two icon frames; turning it off restores a static icon. Honors the system reduced-motion setting.

assetsHint.message: Downloads images, CSS, and fonts in the background; scripts are archived only, never executed

clearAssetsHint.message: Only clears the cache; captures and folders are untouched

loginSub.message: Email sign-up / sign-in with cross-device sync. Planned for v2; this version is local-only.

stateDeleteOn.message: Active: confirmation required (try × in the library)

stateDeleteOff.message: Active: delete immediately (try × in the library)

importDoneBar.message: Import complete: $1 captures added; top-level bookmarks folders mapped to business folders

importEmptyBar.message: Import complete: no links found on the bookmarks bar

importEmptyFile.message: Import complete: no links found in $1

assetsBreakdown.message: Images $1 · Styles $2 · Fonts $3 · Scripts archived $4 (never run)

assetsDedupe.message: Deduplicated by original URL; each asset is stored once

clearAssetsConfirm.message: Clear all offline assets? Captures and folders are untouched.

deleteFolderConfirm.message: Delete "$1"? Captures are kept; only the folder is removed.

standaloneHint.message: Sidebar mode · the left drawer still works on other pages

accountSyncHint.message: Sign in with email to sync captures across devices. Unverified emails cannot sync.

signupHint.message: After signing up, confirm via the link in your inbox. Unverified accounts cannot sync.

dailyAutoSyncHint.message: Once a day; catches up when the browser starts

unverifiedBlocked.message: Email not verified: sync is disabled. Confirm via the link in your inbox, then come back.

modeBoth.message: Two-way: exchange deltas, newer update wins

confirmEmailSent.message: Confirmation email sent. Click the link in your inbox, then sign in here.

resetMailSent.message: Password reset email sent (open Mailpit at :54324 for local testing)

signedOut.message: Signed out. Local captures are untouched.
